verdict.rationale:
Bruno supports multiple named environments with variable overrides and a mock-response feature, which lets users point requests at a sandbox/staging environment instead of production, and its offline-only, local-first storage keeps test data out of any shared/production systems. However there's no explicit 'sandbox mode' guardrail or documentation describing preventing production writes, and the AI-native framing (agents automatically choosing safe environments) isn't evidenced.
missing for 10: explicit sandbox-vs-production safety guardrails, agent-aware environment selection, hands-on confirmation of mock/environment reliability.
